title: Next Step Task Manifest
description: Structure of a task zip's manifest. Fields formalized from the real ABX-STEP v1.2.0 manifest contract (PROTOCOL-FACTS.md, task.manifest.demo) — this is a direct port of an existing, exercised format, not a new design.

PROTOCOL_VERSION.description: Next Step protocol version this manifest conforms to.

TASK_ID.description: Full UUID. The real identity of the task — receipts, approvals, and locks are keyed on this, never on the human-facing sequence number.

CREATED_BY.description: Identity of the creating agent (e.g. 'AI', or a specific agent identifier).

WORKSPACE_ID.description: The claiming workspace's ID. Must correspond to an existing entry under workspace/registry/.

WORKSPACE_NAME.description: Not hand-authored — looked up from workspace/registry/<WORKSPACE_ID>/name and injected at build time. Present here because it is a mandatory field of the built manifest, even though it is not a template substitution.

TASK_INTENT.description: Human-readable description of what this task does.

TASK_CONTENT_HASH.description: Hash binding this manifest to its task contents. 'PENDING' is a valid pre-build placeholder value; must be a real hash by the time the task is staged.

WRITE_PATHS.description: Comma-separated relative write paths, or the literal string 'NONE'. Any path resolving outside the claiming workspace's root (absolute path, '..', '~') is rejected at manifest-validation time, before staging.

IDEMPOTENCY_MODE.description: Only SAFE is defined in the inherited contract; task authors must write start.sh to be safely re-runnable.

INTERRUPTION_POLICY.description: Only this value is attested in the inherited contract; other interruption policies are not yet defined.
